title: Heat reminders
intro: Optional reminders to drink water and take a rest break when the heat index is high. Only you see them.
notice: Heat reminders are estimates from the weather forecast, not medical advice. Stop and rest any time you feel unwell. Vireek does not contact emergency services. If someone may be in danger, call your local emergency number first.
off: Your company has not turned heat reminders on.

optIn.label: Send me heat reminders
optIn.hint: Your choice. You can turn this off at any time and nobody is told either way.

start.zipLabel: ZIP code where you are working
start.zipHint: 5-digit US ZIP. Used only to look up the weather; your phone location is not used.

errors.heat_disabled: Your company has not turned heat reminders on.
errors.not_opted_in: Turn on heat reminders for yourself first.

live.heading: Right now near {{zip}}
live.source: Estimated from the National Weather Service hourly forecast, not a sensor reading.
live.stale: This reading is out of date, so no new reminders are being sent. Check conditions yourself.
live.weatherError: Could not get the weather just now. Reminders pause until it is back.

prompt.rest: Time for a rest break in the shade or a cool spot.

incident: If something happens, log it with the incident form below.

settings.title: Heat reminders
settings.intro: Reminders go to the technician only, and only technicians who turn them on. Nobody else is alerted and emergency services are never contacted. The lone-worker check-in is separate.
settings.enable: Turn on heat reminders for my team
settings.enableHint: Each technician still has to opt in for themselves.
settings.invalid: Each level needs 0 (off) or a whole number from 5 to 480.
settings.defaultsNote: These starting values are conservative company defaults, not a standard. Confirm them with your safety officer.
